resources.string: The Material 3-style interface is now enabled by default. If you prefer the old design, go to Settings → Experimental features → “New Material 3 interface” and turn off “Enable the new interface”.\n\nThis notice will appear three times, once per launch. After three confirmations, it will not appear again. You can change your design choice in settings at any time.
